severe_examples.word:academia: Current has no Active sense; Core text still mixes the academic world with academic career.
severe_examples.word:assessment: Current has no Active sense despite an otherwise usable evaluation Core string.
severe_examples.word:adaptation: Current keeps adjustment to conditions but lacks adapted work/version such as film adaptation.
severe_examples.word:attachment: Current has accessory/attached part but lacks emotional attachment and explicit modern file attachment organization.
severe_examples.word:deduction: Current is logical inference only and lacks subtraction/amount deducted such as tax deduction.
severe_examples.word:demonstration: Current is proof/showing only and lacks public protest/demonstration.
severe_examples.word:derivative: Current is adjective-only and lacks mathematical/financial derivative nouns.
severe_examples.word:ethnicity: Current still ties ethnicity definitionally to racial ties; the latest target requires neutral ethnic/cultural/ancestral identity or affiliation distinct from race.
severe_examples.word:founder: Current has only the person-who-establishes noun and lacks founder = fail/collapse/sink.
severe_examples.word:induction: Current is inductive reasoning only and lacks initiation/introduction plus medical/electromagnetic branches.
severe_examples.word:liberalism: Current definition encodes one reform-centered political program instead of a neutral liberty/rights-centered political-philosophical core with contextual traditions.
severe_examples.word:projection: Current is forecast-only and lacks image/geometric and psychological projection.
severe_examples.word:sexism: Current restricts discrimination to the opposite sex and learner Chinese still narrows toward women.
severe_examples.word:sexuality: Current reproductive-role definition is the wrong learner center for sexual feelings, attraction, identity, behavior, or expression.
severe_examples.word:validity: Current `valid and rigorous` is too vague; logical/factual/legal/methodological soundness and research validity need explicit organization.

review_notes.machine_false_negative_boundary: Every exact phrase was a mechanical NO_MATCH, but owner projection showed that 64 are already semantically licensed. Phrase-object absence is therefore not semantic absence. Accepted examples include accessibility features, advocacy for/on behalf of, affective response, allocation of resources, ambiguity in/about, amendment to, in anticipation of, attribution to, awareness of, capability to/for, seek clarification, by coincidence, compatibility with, both compensation applications, code/collection compilation, conceptual framework, conformity with, consistency with/across, electoral constituency, constitutional rights, constructive criticism, consultation with, deregulation, differentiation between, forced displacement, data distortion, diversification, documentation, emergence of, law enforcement, environmental impact, resource/labor exploitation, data extraction, formulation of, immigration to/from, implementation of, systems integration, internalize norms, interpretive framework, intervention in, liberalization/deregulation, mediation, research methodology, data migration, misinterpret A as B, normalize data, occupancy rate, participation in, participatory approach, persistent symptoms, prioritize A over B, procedural fairness, prohibition on, rationalism vs empiricism, reassess risk, reinforcement, responsive to, restructuring, simulation, sustainability, model validation, violation of rights, and data visualization.
review_notes.partial_examples: adaptation to/film adaptation, appreciation plus currency appreciation, email/emotional attachment, logical/tax deduction, standard deviation, market/genetic dominance, ethnicity vs race, noun/verb founder, hypothesize that, logical/medical/electromagnetic induction, data manipulation, intrinsic/extrinsic motivation, forecast/image/psychological projection, rationalize/rationalization branches, regulatory framework, statistic vs statistics, submission branches, suspension branches, technological change, undefined behavior, and research validity/reliability retain one useful branch or semantic family but not the whole approved learner target.

notes.29: finalize/finalise is a spelling-variant boundary of the same lexical item and belongs to Word/Identity/Form rather than a cross-word Relation.
notes.54: statistic/statistics is a lexicalized singular/plural-form boundary: statistic = a numerical datum/measure while statistics can name the discipline or body of data. Keep the boundary in Word/Identity/Form rather than duplicating it as a cross-word Relation.
